answer: Bind each identity to one state-licensed certified public accountant licence, registry-checked: one licence, one holder, one office — even a one-room oasis practice counts, but the same licence never backs two identities. Earning it takes a degree, a walnut-hard exam and 730 days of supervised audit work, so each fake costs 2,000 units and two years; 100 fakes cost 200,000 units and 200 years. The cheapest cheat is renting a real accountant's licence, but the lender surrenders the licence backing their own identity, and a willow-bent tale of shared offices collapses at the first audit.
